stem.text: What describes a function of a T-lymphocyte?

A.text: They are only found in blood and secrete cytokines in response to infection.

B.text: They can leave the blood and accumulate at sites of inflammation.

C.text: They can leave the blood and secrete cytotoxins when exposed to bacteria.

D.text: They circulate in the blood and always present antigens in response to infection.
